newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-TOULON'S MOREAU JOINS FRENCH EXODUS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TOULON'S MOREAU JOINS FRENCH EXODUS.

text.p: Midfielder Fabrice Moreau has joined an unprecedented exodus of French players to foreign clubs this season by moving to Spanish first division Rayo Vallecano from second division Toulon for one million francs ($200,000).
The former Marseille player could make his debut for Rayo against Hercules Alicante on October 13.
About 30 French players are plying their trade with foreign clubs this season. The traffic has been two-way, with 40 foreigners joining French first division clubs.
